editorialApproach: All hairstyle descriptions, routines, outfit ideas and hex swatches are original editorial content. Images are AI-generated illustrations. Trim intervals are flexible examples, not universal requirements. The 12 palettes are an illustrative website framework and are not an official palette from any cited provider.

sources.title: Hair styling without damage
sources.supports: General caution about excessive heat and tight styles. The guides favour gentle handling, comfortable tension and lower heat rather than promising that a style prevents damage.

sources.title: 6 curly hair care tips from dermatologists
sources.supports: General curly and coily hair-care principles: conditioning, gentle detangling and managing long or thick hair in sections. Individual routines vary.

sources.title: Colour Analysis
sources.supports: Seasonal styling vocabulary based on hue, value and chroma: warm/cool, light/deep and soft/clear. The site adapts these dimensions into an original exploratory tool. Commercial colour-analysis guidance is styling expertise, not a scientific validation of this questionnaire.

sources.title: Your Colour Masterclass
sources.supports: Colour exists on a spectrum, with variation within seasonal palettes. Neighbouring palettes and uncertain results are therefore presented as options rather than definitive labels.

limitations: A screen, photograph, generated image or brief self-assessment cannot replace physical fabric comparison under consistent lighting.
Palette names describe colour combinations, not gender, ethnicity or skin-tone categories.
The questionnaire uses an openly documented equal-weight editorial heuristic; it does not estimate diagnostic confidence.
The site makes no health, scientific validity or universally protective hairstyle claims.
